2608.20756.title: Vis-Poison: Poisoning Visual Knowledge in Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation
2608.20756.paper_summary: While multimodal retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems increasingly rely on images as external knowledge sources, the introduction of poisoned visual evidence can severely compromise multimodal large language model (MLLM) generation. Unlike prior attacks that rely on altering textual metadata, we introduce Vis-Poison, a novel visual knowledge poisoning attack where the poisoned image itself is the attacker-controlled payload, without manipulating captions, summaries, metadata, or other associated text. Specifically, this attack is instantiated through an automated multi-agent method that constructs visually plausible poisoned images. To assess its impact, we evaluate Vis-Poison across two representative multimodal RAG pipelines, four embedding models, and six generation models. Empirically, Vis-Poison achieves an end-to-end attack success rate of 40.16\% to 65.40\% against 30k-entry multimodal knowledge bases in \emph{black-box} settings. Moreover, Vis-Poison remains effective against various MLLMs that can answer correctly from parametric knowledge alone, with an average success rate above 60\%. Code and data are available at https://github.com/SWUFE-DB-Group/Vis-Poison.
2608.20756.paper_summary_zh: 雖然多模態檢索增強生成（RAG）系統越來越依賴圖像作為外部知識來源，但引入被污染的視覺證據可能會嚴重損害多模態大型語言模型（MLLM）的生成。與之前依賴改變文本元數據的攻擊不同，我們引入了Vis-Poison，一種新穎的視覺知識污染攻擊，其中被污染的圖像本身就是攻擊者控制的有效載荷，而不需要操控標題、摘要、元數據或其他相關文本。具體來說，這種攻擊是通過一種自動化的多代理方法來實現的，該方法構建了視覺上合理的被污染圖像。為了評估其影響，我們在兩個具有代表性的多模態RAG管道、四個嵌入模型和六個生成模型上評估了Vis-Poison。實證結果顯示，Vis-Poison在\emph{黑箱}環境下對30k條目多模態知識庫的端到端攻擊成功率達到40.16\%至65.40\%。此外，Vis-Poison對於能夠僅依賴參數知識正確回答的各種MLLM仍然有效，平均成功率超過60\%。代碼和數據可在https://github.com/SWUFE-DB-Group/Vis-Poison獲取。
